Q: iOS (iPhone, iPad, iPodTouch) view real-time console log terminal A:

With go-ios, which is a cross-platform CLI application, you can get the logs as follows:

ios tunnel start --userspace  # in the first terminal (may not be required)
ios syslog                    # in a second terminal

Q: Spring Boot 3.x With WebClient and ObservationWebClientCustomizer A:

For HttpClient (reactor.netty.http.client.HttpClient), enable the metrics with httpClient= HttpClient.create().metrics(true, uri -> "/{**}"); or something like that. See its javadoc for details. It requires Micrometer and a tracer, otherwise it throws an explicit exception with how to solve it. An alternative would be to create the HttpClient from a ConnectionProvider and there activate the metrics, as explained in https://projectreactor.io/docs/netty/release/reference/http-client.html#_metrics

For WebClient (org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient) as you wish, if not already so, build it with such an HttpClient: webClient = WebClient.builder().clientConnector(new ReactorClientHttpConnector(httpClient)).build(); and possibly other parameters from the builder.

Q: insert multiple records for multiple tables in a single query A:

PostgreSQL v17+ offers a merge..returning, which can reference both source and target table: demo at db<>fiddle

with cte as(
  merge into person
  using old_account
  on false
  when not matched then
    insert default values
  returning person.id
           ,old_account.uid)
insert into account(person,uid)
table cte;

The table is a shorthand for select * from.

You can also create the account first and make it generate the new person.id, before actually creating a person with that id. Since that's a regular insert, its returning clause can only reference the target table:

with cte as(
  insert into account(person,uid)
  select nextval(pg_get_serial_sequence('person','id'))
        ,uid
  from old_account
  returning person as person_id)
insert into person 
overriding system value
select person_id from cte;

This is pretty much what you intially attempted with an insert..returning id inside a scalar subquery. The nextval() call is what insert..default would do, so you're simply doing that on your own, earlier, then hand that id back to it.
Even though you're working with identity columns that superseded serial types, your identities are still backed up by sequences tied to columns, so pg_get_serial_sequence() still works.

INSERT..OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE lets you side-step the bigint generated always as identity expression on person.id. If you instead made it generated BY DEFAULT, that happens on its own, without having to explicitly override.

Unlike UNIQUE constraints, REFERENCES aren't validated mid-statement when set up as non-deferrable, which is why you can reference the not-yet created person inside the CTE, then spawn it outside.

Q: Selenium ChromeDriver not working in JavaFX application packaged as an exe A:

You saw it right.

Selenium Manager

The Selenium project has integrated Selenium Manager the official driver manager for Selenium which is shipped out of the box with each Selenium release since version 4.6. Selenium Manager is a command-line tool which is being implemented in Rust that provides automated driver and browser management for Selenium. Currently all the Selenium bindings use this tool by default, so you do not need to download it or add bonigarcia:webdrivermanager or do anything else to use it. Selenium Manager is the official driver manager of the Selenium project, and it is shipped out of the box with every Selenium release.

So invariably Selenium v4.40.0 does includes the support of Selenium Manager.

Further this log message:

SeleniumUtil - next line is new ChromeDriver(). Driver system location: C:\Users\cdavi\.cache\selenium\chromedriver\win64\144.0.7559.133\chromedriver.exe

is perfect, the current latest official google-chrome browser version being Version 144.0.7559.133

Issue & Solution

Most possible reason behind your class hangs is because of a few unwanted arguments. Comment out the following arguments which are not mandatory for google-chrome-headless:

options.addArguments("--disable-gpu");
options.addArguments("--disable-extensions");
options.addArguments("--disable-background-networking");
options.addArguments("--remote-debugging-pipe");
options.addArguments("--window-size=1280,800"); //no more supported, see https://stackoverflow.com/a/79755173/7429447
options.addArguments("--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled");
options.setExperimentalOption("excludeSwitches", Collections.singleton("enable-automation"));

Additionally remove the line:

WebDriverManager.chromedriver().setup();

to stop using WebDriverManager.

Further ensure that Selenium is upgraded to recent v4.40 and then re-execute your class.
